name: MH3G normalized controller-input candidate
purpose_zh: 在 0x02BCB9CC 写入归一化按住位之前记录 r29 和输入对象，验证 MH3G 内部 A/L/R 掩码分别为 0x2000/0x0100/0x0200。只观察，不修改控制器状态。
purpose_en: Record r29 and the input object immediately before 0x02BCB9CC stores normalized held buttons, proving MH3G internal A/L/R masks 0x2000/0x0100/0x0200. Observe only; do not modify controller state.
operator_steps_zh: 进入可以自由操控猎人的任务；每次 tracer 只设一个一次性断点，分别在不按键、只按 A、只按 L、只按 R 时各采集一份 JSONL。
断点命中时以 GPR r29 为本帧归一化 hold mask；r31+0x64 在该指令执行前仍可能是上一帧值，不能拿旧内存代替 r29。
要求四次 trace 的差分分别证明 A=0x2000、L=0x0100、R=0x0200，并确认没有其他按键噪声，才可升级输入映射。
operator_steps_en: Enter a quest with free hunter control. Use the one-shot tracer separately while holding no button, A only, L only, and R only, producing one JSONL per condition.
At the breakpoint, GPR r29 is the current normalized hold mask. Because the store has not executed yet, r31+0x64 may still contain the prior frame and must not replace r29 as evidence.
Require the four trace differences to prove A=0x2000, L=0x0100, and R=0x0200 without unrelated button noise before promoting the input mapping.
